    protocol=root/'.runs'/('runtime030-'+name+'-001')/'protocol.json';assert p.sha(protocol)==pin;plan=read(protocol);out=Path(plan['output']);child=read(out/'result.json');iscomp=name.startswith('comparison');ctx={}

        source=Path(plan['source']);hashes=plan['source_hashes'];expected=plan['expected_counts'];nprotected=plan['expected_protected_count'];assert [x['stage'] for x in child['processes']]==['preview','route','review','choice','export','verify_export']

        assert [data['native'][k] for k in ('opens','blocking','warnings','exclusions')]==expected and data['metrics']['version']=='10.0.7' and data['schematic_parity']=='checked by final native DRC'
        assert p.sha(Path(data['candidate']))==data['candidate_sha256'] and all(x in p.routes(p.sx.read(Path(data['candidate']))) for x in protected)

    result['cases'].append({'name':'invalid-'+suffix,'protocol_sha256':p.sha(protocol),'child_sha256':p.sha(out/'result.json'),'status':data['status'],'control_passed':data['control_passed'],'error':data.get('error'),'cases':rows})
print(json.dumps(result))
